rationale: Producer recommendation: no operative original order as of 2026-10-14, because EO:14029 §1, signed 2021-05-14; lists EO13964 among actions hereby revoked. Exact official original inspected: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2020-12-15/pdf/2020-27740.pdf (SHA-256 de0691f48d38e6e67435add40b6d6b7a45a50efbb489506f65bce4eba03655f9, 85 FR 81333, PDF pages 1-3). Acting original inspected: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2021-05-19/pdf/2021-10691.pdf (SHA-256 eb3d5e1b1d96e89e74cac80c628b3cb98b0b92c67cc0624794cb1995e3fcb909, 86 FR 27025, PDF pages 1-2). This establishes formal revocation at the acting order's signed date, not that this was the earliest clause cessation. For EO13964, EO14148 §2(gg) later revokes EO14029, but does not list EO13964 or state it is restored; the full EO14148 original was checked (90 FR 8237-8241; SHA-256 d658f5158a27f6d4a220ce2ec854bdbd596ecc841fb16884954a2e2ee39ab072). For EO13910/13991/13998, EO14148 does not list EO14122; there is no 14148-to-14122 rescission on the inspected original and thus no revival path to infer. Status remains a producer recommendation only because the complete later-source/reinstatement search through the 2026-10-14 cutoff has not been performed and independent status review remains required.
